notes.title: Its been a while
notes.content:
Hello! I know, I know, its been a while. Long story short, I have been taking a well-earned break the past few weeks. Recently I've started working on the next major update to the game... which isn't ready just yet.

No teasers at the moment, but in the meantime here are a few hints at the upcoming content:

[list]
[*] It swims
 
[*] It flies

[*] It travels in large groups

[*] It is colorful
[/list]

Any guess as to what it could be???

notes.title: New Update Name Announced!
notes.content:
Version 1.2.0 will contain various species from the Rodent Genus [i]Apodemus[/i]. 
This update will also contain various tweaks to the two species of weasel currently in game. Changes will be made to their attack damage so that they have higher damage as juveniles and lower damage as adults. Weasels in the game are intended to be small game specialists that wear down their opponents with stamina, which will be reflected with a speed nerf to the weasels in favor of better stamina and stamina regen.

notes.title: Update 1.2 coming soon!
notes.content:
This update will contain a few new animals and various tweaks to existing animals.
Its too early to give a release date for the update at this time. But just so that you are prepared, the update will contain a call for the Red Fox, which was requested by my beta testers. Red Fox have very 
shrill calls that can be quite frightening to the untrained ear.
